newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kepphil breaks ground for new dry dock.
newsitem.headline: Kepphil breaks ground for new dry dock.

text.p: Kepphil Shipyard Inc, a member of Singapore's Keppel Group, has broken ground for its new 40,000 dwt drydock at Batangas in the Philippines, a Keppel statement said on Tuesday.

The new drydock, valued at 500 million pesos, will take about 15 months to complete. Construction of the drydock has been awarded to CCT Constructors Corporation, a subsidiary of Japan's Toyo Construction Company.
Keppel said the drydock is being constructed with provisions to expand it further to 70,000 dwt, capable of accommodating Panamax-sized vessels.
